text:
Ava: Quick sync — sketching a compact UX for a "targeted fallback by entropy" mode. Goal: let product owners opt some traffic into a cheaper/safer model variant based on output entropy + error signals, without global blunt thresholds. Thoughts?

Marco: short + nice. curious how this differs from sampling-based canaries we already have?

Ava: good q — sampling-based canaries pick user %s. this is per-request decision: if model reply entropy < X OR error-rate > Y then route to fallback variant. helps e.g., high-confidence deterministic replies use cheaper quantized model.

Priya: love the idea. main UX worries: clarity on why a request was routed, and auditability (we need to replay decisions). also guardrails for oscillation.

Sven: agree on replay. also need operator override + per-route allowlist. Some routes (payments) must never fallback.

Ava: yes — plan: UI shows a compact policy editor with these fields:
- enabled (bool)
- entropy_threshold (float)
- error_rate_window (m, errors per 1000)
- fallback_variant (dropdown)
- allowlist (route patterns)
- dry_run (toggle)

Marco: can you paste a quick example policy blob for the API? saves back-and-forth.

Ava: sure — example: 
```json
{
  "mode": "targeted_entropy",
  "entropy_threshold": 2.3,
  "error_rate_window_ms": 60000,
  "error_rate_threshold_per_1k": 5,
  "fallback_variant": "quant-4g",
  "allowlist_routes": ["/payments/*"],
  "dry_run": true
}
```

Priya: looks good. two asks: (1) expose a reason code API for each request (e.g. "entropy_low", "error_spike", "manual_override"); (2) include a sampling-tag so we can record examples for evals.

Ava: yep. UX items: in console we'll show a little badge on requests that were rerouted with reason + link to replay. Also add a histogram of entropy distribution and weekly "audit sample" bucket.

Sven: what about TTL for decisions? e.g., if a request hits fallback once, should subsequent messages in same session keep hitting fallback? otherwise oscillation on boundary cases.

Marco: propose session sticky window param (e.g., 5m). keep sticky as optional in policy.

Ava: adding: "stickiness_seconds": 300 (0 = off).

Priya: telemetry: we need a per-policy timeseries: total requests, routed_count, avg_latency delta, cost delta, and false-positive rate estimate (based on eval set). console should surface these and let owners pin a threshold for automated rollback.

Ava: agree. also add an audit log export for every routed decision with: timestamp, request_id, route, entropy, reason_code, model_from, model_to, operator (if any).

OpsBot: CI check passed for policy editor prototype: https://ci.internal/redwood/targeted-entropy-ui/45 :green_heart:

Marco: security question — who can edit allowlist? need RBAC tie to team + enterprise policies.

Ava: plan: tie edits to RBAC roles: "policy_admin", "policy_viewer". also require 2FA for production toggles and a change justification field on save (free-text).

Priya: nice. last UX nit: when dry_run=true, show a counterfactual column: "would_have_routed" so owners can see impact before flipping.

Ava: already on the board. Also adding a tiny preview modal to run a sample of recent requests through the rule with explanations (entropy calc, error windows).

Sven: about API semantics — we should add an optional "entropy_source" param (e.g., "topk_entropy", "token_entropy_avg") because different models/decoding strategies produce different numbers.

Ava: good call. also exposing seed for deterministic sampling (for reproducible audits).

Marco: implementation note: runtime should annotate trace/span with "fallback.decision=<code>" and attach decision payload as indexed metadata for fast queries.

Priya: and please add an alerting hook: if routed_count spikes > threshold, page owners. want to avoid silent cost regressions.

Ava: yep — alert + Slack notif + auto-dry-run if cost delta > X% (configurable).

Sven: OK if I mock a compact layout in Figma and drop it here later?

Ava: please do. thanks all. follow-ups: Marco to scope backend index changes, Priya to spec telemetry metrics, Sven to mock UI, I'll wire RBAC + API schema.

Marco: will do. ETA EOW for backend sketch.
